translation: Took place in posad Serock, 3 March [corrected from February] 1890, 9 PM. Appeared personally Abram Wajngrod[?], szkolnik, 60, and Moszek Zylbersztejn, trader, 33, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 7 AM in posad Serock died a child of male sex named [unclear: Joel/Uel] Cukier, son of Szlama and of the mother Sura nee Motkiewicz[?], aged nine months. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of this child, this act was read to the witnesses and signed by them and by us.
